description: Bounded sorted list with insertion that preserves the non-decreasing order. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/sorted_list — verified ordered sequence'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/safe_queue.mm and std/container/bounded_array.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm, safe_queue.mm, and bounded_array.mm already use (checked_add, checked_sub, conditional expressions, comparisons).

atoms.name: sorted_insert_position
atoms.description: Compute the insertion index for a new value into a sorted list of length len, given a candidate position pos that the caller already proved monotone w.r.t. the inserted value. The result is in [0, len].

atoms.name: sorted_insert_len
atoms.description: Length update after a sorted insertion. Requires len < cap so the bound is preserved.

atoms.name: sorted_is_ordered_pair
atoms.description: Witness predicate that two adjacent values are in non-decreasing order. Returns 1 when a <= b, 0 otherwise. Z3 integer theory verifies the predicate trivially.
